records.detail: 128 Vitest tests verify TravelIntent, RouteOptimization, CostEpistemic, OfferVariant invariants.
Negative controls (HAN->KUL, order randomization, BKK vs DMK, direct vs connecting) pass deterministically.
Fail-closed reader returns degraded_schema if active_generation_id is missing; partial candidate generation is quarantined and deleted instead of activated.
Explicit regression passes: target price <= 5,000,000 with 5% discount matches without 20% discount suppression; alert processor pagination is exhaustive without 5000 score-based cutoff.
Includes departure_from and departure_to in user_preferences export query; account deletion RPC cascades across all user tables.
Canonical product event taxonomy (opportunity_open, verify_click, page_view, etc.) and metadata (opportunity_id, synthetic, page) tested and validated.
searchDealsWithStatus models provider_unavailable, degraded, and healthy_empty states; UI distinguishes network/provider failure from 0 matching deals.
Strict row level security verified across anon and authenticated users on all tables.
No longitudinal production booking outcome fabrication permitted.
